title: Topology interfaces imported by the discrete book

blocks.tex:
This is a partial catalog of existing interfaces in
\texttt{ForMathlib/Analysis/Complex/WindingNumber.lean},
\texttt{ForMathlib/Analysis/Complex/PoincareMiranda.lean}, and
\texttt{Gluck/Winding.lean}.  The statements and sketches below were read
from those project sources.  In particular the \texttt{Complex} names below
belong to the project's \texttt{ForMathlib} library, not an asserted upstream
Mathlib API.  This catalog neither replaces their full smooth-book chapters
nor certifies compilation.  It contains no new producer for the discrete
converse.  All labels are local to the discrete book.

Put $I=[0,1]$ and write $C(I,X)$ for bundled continuous maps.
Private normalization and covering-lift helpers are described inside the
sketches; only the listed public interfaces are pinned here.

blocks.label: def:discrete_import_winding_at
blocks.title: Winding about an avoided point
blocks.body:
For $w\in\mathbb C$, $\gamma\in C(I,\mathbb C)$, and a proof that
$\gamma(t)\ne w$ for every $t$, radially normalize $\gamma-w$ to the unit
circle.  Lift that path along $\operatorname{Circle.exp}$ to a continuous
real angle $\phi$, using the chosen initial preimage.  Define
$W_w(\gamma)=(\phi(1)-\phi(0))/(2\pi)$.
The definition allows open paths; it does not assume $\gamma(0)=\gamma(1)$.

lean.name: Complex.windingNumberAt
lean.code:
noncomputable def windingNumberAt (w : ℂ) (γ : C(I, ℂ)) (hγ : ∀ t, γ t ≠ w) : ℝ :=
  windingNumber (normLoopAt w γ hγ)

blocks.label: lem:discrete_import_winding_congr
blocks.title: Pointwise congruence
blocks.body:
Pointwise equal continuous paths avoiding the same $w$ have equal $W_w$,
regardless of the proofs of avoidance used in the definition.

lean.name: Complex.windingNumberAt_congr
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberAt_congr {w : ℂ} {γ γ' : C(I, ℂ)} {hγ : ∀ t, γ t ≠ w}
    {hγ' : ∀ t, γ' t ≠ w} (he : ∀ t, γ t = γ' t) :
    windingNumberAt w γ hγ = windingNumberAt w γ' hγ' := by
  obtain rfl : γ = γ' := ContinuousMap.ext he
  rfl

blocks.tex:
Continuous-map extensionality identifies the paths; proof irrelevance
identifies their avoidance arguments.

blocks.label: lem:discrete_import_winding_lift
blocks.title: Evaluation from a polar lift
blocks.body:
If $\phi\in C(I,\mathbb R)$ and
$\gamma(t)-w=\|\gamma(t)-w\|e^{i\phi(t)}$ for every $t$, with
$\gamma(t)\ne w$, then $W_w(\gamma)=(\phi(1)-\phi(0))/(2\pi)$.

lean.name: Complex.windingNumberAt_eq_div_of_lift
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberAt_eq_div_of_lift {w : ℂ} {γ : C(I, ℂ)} (hγ : ∀ t, γ t ≠ w) (φ : C(I, ℝ))
    (hφ : ∀ t, γ t - w = ‖γ t - w‖ * exp (φ t * Complex.I)) :
    windingNumberAt w γ hγ = (φ 1 - φ 0) / (2 * π) := by
  refine windingNumber_eq_div_of_lift _ φ fun t ↦ ?_
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [Circle.coe_exp]
  change exp ((φ t : ℂ) * Complex.I) = (γ t - w) / (‖γ t - w‖ : ℂ)
  rw [eq_div_iff (by exact_mod_cast norm_ne_zero_iff.2 (sub_ne_zero.2 (hγ t)))]
  linear_combination -hφ t

/-- A constant curve has winding number `0` about any point it avoids. -/
@[simp]

blocks.tex:
Divide the polar identity by its nonzero norm.  This makes $\phi$ a lift of
the normalized path.  Two lifts differ by a constant multiple of $2\pi$,
so their endpoint increments agree.

blocks.label: lem:discrete_import_winding_const
blocks.title: Constant paths
blocks.body: For $z\ne w$, the constant path with value $z$ has $W_w=0$.

lean.name: Complex.windingNumberAt_const
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberAt_const (w z : ℂ) (h : ∀ t : I, (ContinuousMap.const I z) t ≠ w) :
    windingNumberAt w (ContinuousMap.const I z) h = 0 := by
  have hnl : normLoopAt w (ContinuousMap.const I z) h
      = ContinuousMap.const I (circleProjAt w z (h 0)) :=
    ContinuousMap.ext fun t ↦ circleProjAt_congr (h t) (h 0) rfl
  rw [windingNumberAt, hnl, windingNumber_const]

blocks.tex: Its normalized path has a constant angle lift, hence zero increment.

blocks.label: thm:discrete_import_winding_homotopy
blocks.title: Free homotopy through avoiding loops
blocks.body:
Let $\gamma_0,\gamma_1\in C(I,\mathbb C)$ avoid $w$.  Let
$H\in C(I\times I,\mathbb C)$ avoid $w$ everywhere, with
$H(0,t)=\gamma_0(t)$, $H(1,t)=\gamma_1(t)$, and
$H(s,0)=H(s,1)$ for all $s$.  Then $W_w(\gamma_0)=W_w(\gamma_1)$.
No common fixed base point of the loops is required.

lean.name: Complex.windingNumberAt_eq_of_homotopy
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberAt_eq_of_homotopy (w : ℂ) (γ₀ γ₁ : C(I, ℂ))
    (hγ₀ : ∀ t, γ₀ t ≠ w) (hγ₁ : ∀ t, γ₁ t ≠ w)
    (H : C(I × I, ℂ)) (hH : ∀ st, H st ≠ w)
    (h0 : ∀ t, H (0, t) = γ₀ t) (h1 : ∀ t, H (1, t) = γ₁ t)
    (hloop : ∀ s, H (s, 0) = H (s, 1)) :
    windingNumberAt w γ₀ hγ₀ = windingNumberAt w γ₁ hγ₁ := by
  set Hn : C(I × I, Circle) :=
    ⟨fun st ↦ circleProjAt w (H st) (hH st),
      continuous_circleProjAt H.continuous hH⟩ with hHndef
  have h0' : ∀ t : I, Hn (0, t) = normLoopAt w γ₀ hγ₀ t := by
    intro t
    change circleProjAt w (H (0, t)) (hH (0, t)) =
      circleProjAt w (γ₀ t) (hγ₀ t)
    exact circleProjAt_congr _ _ (h0 t)
  have h1' : ∀ t : I, Hn (1, t) = normLoopAt w γ₁ hγ₁ t := by
    intro t
    change circleProjAt w (H (1, t)) (hH (1, t)) =
      circleProjAt w (γ₁ t) (hγ₁ t)
    exact circleProjAt_congr _ _ (h1 t)
  have hloop' : ∀ s : I, Hn (s, 0) = Hn (s, 1) := by
    intro s
    change circleProjAt w (H (s, 0)) (hH (s, 0)) =
      circleProjAt w (H (s, 1)) (hH (s, 1))
    exact circleProjAt_congr _ _ (hloop s)
  exact windingNumber_eq_of_homotopy Hn h0' h1' hloop'

blocks.tex:
Radially normalize the whole homotopy and lift it along the circle
covering.  The endpoint increment divided by $2\pi$ varies continuously
with $s$ and is integer-valued because every row is closed.  It is constant
on the connected interval.  Lift uniqueness identifies the endpoint values
with the winding numbers in the statement.

blocks.label: lem:discrete_import_winding_mul
blocks.title: Product of nonvanishing paths
blocks.body:
For paths $\gamma,\gamma'$ avoiding zero,
$W_0(\gamma\gamma')=W_0(\gamma)+W_0(\gamma')$.

lean.name: Complex.windingNumberAt_mul
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberAt_mul (γ γ' : C(I, ℂ)) (hγ : ∀ t, γ t ≠ 0) (hγ' : ∀ t, γ' t ≠ 0) :
    windingNumberAt 0 (γ * γ') (fun t ↦ mul_ne_zero (hγ t) (hγ' t))
      = windingNumberAt 0 γ hγ + windingNumberAt 0 γ' hγ' := by
  have hnl : normLoopAt 0 (γ * γ') (fun t ↦ mul_ne_zero (hγ t) (hγ' t))
      = normLoopAt 0 γ hγ * normLoopAt 0 γ' hγ' :=
    ContinuousMap.ext fun t ↦ circleProjAt_zero_mul (hγ t) (hγ' t)
  rw [windingNumberAt, hnl, windingNumber_mul, windingNumberAt, windingNumberAt]

blocks.tex:
Radial normalization commutes with multiplication, and the sum of two
angle lifts lifts the product.  Endpoint increments add.

blocks.label: lem:discrete_import_winding_const_mul
blocks.title: Constant complex scaling
blocks.body: For $c\ne0$ and a path $\gamma$ avoiding zero, $W_0(c\gamma)=W_0(\gamma)$.

lean.name: Complex.windingNumberAt_const_mul
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberAt_const_mul (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (γ : C(I, ℂ)) (hγ : ∀ t, γ t ≠ 0) :
    windingNumberAt 0 (ContinuousMap.const I c * γ) (fun t ↦ mul_ne_zero hc (hγ t))
      = windingNumberAt 0 γ hγ := by
  have h := windingNumberAt_mul (ContinuousMap.const I c) γ (fun _ ↦ hc) hγ
  rw [windingNumberAt_const 0 c fun _ ↦ hc, zero_add] at h
  exact h

/-! ### The continuous Rouché theorem ("dog-on-a-leash") -/

blocks.tex: Apply product additivity and the zero winding of the constant path $c$.

blocks.label: lem:discrete_import_winding_exp_int
blocks.title: Integer exponential loop
blocks.body:
For every integer $k$, the path $t\mapsto e^{2\pi i k t}$ avoids zero
and has $W_0=k$.

lean.name: Complex.windingNumberAt_exp_int_mul
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberAt_exp_int_mul (n : ℤ) :
    windingNumberAt 0
      ⟨fun t : I ↦ exp ((2 * π * n * t : ℝ) * Complex.I), by fun_prop⟩
      (fun _ ↦ exp_ne_zero _) = n := by
  rw [windingNumberAt_eq_div_of_lift (fun _ ↦ exp_ne_zero _)
    ⟨fun t : I ↦ 2 * π * n * t, by fun_prop⟩ fun t ↦ by
      change exp ((2 * π * n * t : ℝ) * Complex.I) - 0
        = (‖exp (((2 * π * n * t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 0‖ : ℂ)
          * exp (((2 * π * n * t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      rw [sub_zero, norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, ofReal_one, one_mul]]
  have h2pi : (2 * π : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  change (2 * π * n * ((1 : I) : ℝ) - 2 * π * n * ((0 : I) : ℝ)) / (2 * π) = n
  rw [Set.Icc.coe_one, Set.Icc.coe_zero, mul_one, mul_zero, sub_zero,
    mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ h2pi]

/-! ### The planar degree existence principle -/

blocks.tex:
Use the explicit real lift $2\pi kt$ and its unit modulus, then evaluate
the endpoint increment.

blocks.label: thm:discrete_import_winding_perturb
blocks.title: Symmetric perturbation criterion
blocks.body:
For closed continuous paths $\gamma,\gamma'$ and $w\in\mathbb C$, assume
$\|\gamma'(t)-\gamma(t)\|<\|\gamma(t)-w\|+\|\gamma'(t)-w\|$
at every $t$.  Both paths avoid $w$, and $W_w(\gamma)=W_w(\gamma')$.

lean.name: Complex.windingNumberAt_eq_of_norm_sub_lt
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberAt_eq_of_norm_sub_lt (w : ℂ) (γ γ' : C(I, ℂ))
    (hloopγ : γ 0 = γ 1) (hloopγ' : γ' 0 = γ' 1)
    (hpert : ∀ t, ‖γ' t - γ t‖ < ‖γ t - w‖ + ‖γ' t - w‖) :
    windingNumberAt w γ (ne_of_norm_sub_lt_left hpert) =
      windingNumberAt w γ' (ne_of_norm_sub_lt_right hpert) := by
  have hγ : ∀ t, γ t ≠ w := ne_of_norm_sub_lt_left hpert
  have hγ' : ∀ t, γ' t ≠ w := ne_of_norm_sub_lt_right hpert
  set Hc : I × I → ℂ := fun st ↦ γ st.2 + (st.1 : ℝ) • (γ' st.2 - γ st.2) with hHcdef
  have hHccont : Continuous Hc := by
    rw [hHcdef]
    exact (γ.continuous.comp continuous_snd).add
      ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst).smul
        ((γ'.continuous.comp continuous_snd).sub (γ.continuous.comp continuous_snd)))
  have hHcne : ∀ st : I × I, Hc st ≠ w := by
    intro st
    have hs0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (st.1 : ℝ) := st.1.2.1
    have hs1 : (st.1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 := st.1.2.2
    have hkey : Hc st - w =
        (γ st.2 - w) + (st.1 : ℝ) • ((γ' st.2 - w) - (γ st.2 - w)) := by
      simp only [hHcdef]
      rw [sub_sub_sub_cancel_right]
      abel
    have hpert' : ‖(γ st.2 - w) - (γ' st.2 - w)‖ < ‖γ st.2 - w‖ + ‖γ' st.2 - w‖ := by
      have he : (γ st.2 - w) - (γ' st.2 - w) = γ st.2 - γ' st.2 := by ring
      rw [he, norm_sub_rev]
      exact hpert st.2
    intro hcon
    apply segment_ne_zero hpert' hs0 hs1
    rw [← hkey, hcon, sub_self]
  set H : C(I × I, Circle) :=
    ⟨fun st ↦ circleProjAt w (Hc st) (hHcne st), continuous_circleProjAt hHccont hHcne⟩
  have h0 : ∀ t : I, H (0, t) = normLoopAt w γ hγ t := by
    intro t
    change circleProjAt w (Hc (0, t)) (hHcne (0, t)) = circleProjAt w (γ t) (hγ t)
    apply circleProjAt_congr
    change γ t + ((0 : I) : ℝ) • (γ' t - γ t) = γ t
    rw [Set.Icc.coe_zero, zero_smul, add_zero]
  have h1 : ∀ t : I, H (1, t) = normLoopAt w γ' hγ' t := by
    intro t
    change circleProjAt w (Hc (1, t)) (hHcne (1, t)) = circleProjAt w (γ' t) (hγ' t)
    apply circleProjAt_congr
    change γ t + ((1 : I) : ℝ) • (γ' t - γ t) = γ' t
    rw [Set.Icc.coe_one, one_smul, add_sub_cancel]
  have hloop : ∀ s : I, H (s, 0) = H (s, 1) := by
    intro s
    change circleProjAt w (Hc (s, 0)) (hHcne (s, 0)) = circleProjAt w (Hc (s, 1)) (hHcne (s, 1))
    apply circleProjAt_congr
    change γ (0 : I) + (s : ℝ) • (γ' (0 : I) - γ (0 : I))
      = γ (1 : I) + (s : ℝ) • (γ' (1 : I) - γ (1 : I))
    rw [hloopγ, hloopγ']
  have hinv := windingNumber_eq_of_homotopy H h0 h1 hloop
  rw [windingNumberAt, windingNumberAt, hinv]

/-! ### The boundary loop of a circle -/

blocks.tex:
If either endpoint were $w$, the strict inequality would fail.  If a point
of the segment joining their translated values were zero, the segment
equation would imply equality in this triangle inequality.  Thus the
straight-line homotopy avoids $w$ and remains a homotopy of loops.  Apply
the normalized-loop homotopy argument of the preceding theorem.

blocks.label: def:discrete_import_circle_loop
blocks.title: Circle boundary path
blocks.body:
For $c\in\mathbb C$, $R\in\mathbb R$, and $F$ continuous on
the sphere of center $c$ and radius $|R|$, define the bundled path
$t\mapsto F(c+R e^{2\pi it})$ on $I$.

lean.name: Complex.circleLoop
lean.code:
noncomputable def circleLoop (F : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (R : ℝ)
    (hF : ContinuousOn F (sphere c |R|)) : C(I, ℂ) :=
  ⟨fun t ↦ F (circleMap c R (2 * π * t)), by
    apply hF.comp_continuous
    · exact (continuous_circleMap c R).comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_subtype_val)
    · exact fun t ↦ circleMap_mem_sphere' c R _⟩

/-- Evaluation of the boundary loop: `circleLoop F c R hF t = F (circleMap c R (2 * π * t))`. -/
@[simp]

blocks.label: lem:discrete_import_winding_circle
blocks.title: The positively oriented circle
blocks.body:
For $R>0$, the circle boundary path of the identity with center $c$ and
radius $R$ avoids $c$ and has winding $1$ about $c$.

lean.name: Complex.windingNumberAt_circleLoop_id
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberAt_circleLoop_id (c : ℂ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) :
    windingNumberAt c (circleLoop id c R continuous_id.continuousOn)
      (circleLoop_id_ne c hR.ne') = 1 := by
  have hlift : ∀ t : I,
      Circle.exp ((⟨fun t : I ↦ 2 * π * (t : ℝ), by fun_prop⟩ : C(I, ℝ)) t) =
        normLoopAt c (circleLoop id c R continuous_id.continuousOn)
          (circleLoop_id_ne c hR.ne') t := by
    intro t
    have hsub : circleLoop id c R continuous_id.continuousOn t - c =
        (R : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((2 * π * (t : ℝ) : ℝ) * Complex.I) := by
      change circleMap c R (2 * π * (t : ℝ)) - c = _
      rw [circleMap, add_sub_cancel_left]
    have hnorm : ‖circleLoop id c R continuous_id.continuousOn t - c‖ = R := by
      rw [hsub, norm_mul, norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hR,
        norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, mul_one]
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [Circle.coe_exp]
    change Complex.exp (((2 * π * (t : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
        (circleLoop id c R continuous_id.continuousOn t - c) /
          (‖circleLoop id c R continuous_id.continuousOn t - c‖ : ℂ)
    rw [hnorm, hsub, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (ofReal_ne_zero.2 hR.ne')]
  rw [windingNumberAt, windingNumber_eq_div_of_lift _ _ hlift]
  have h2pi : (2 * π : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  change (2 * π * ((1 : I) : ℝ) - 2 * π * ((0 : I) : ℝ)) / (2 * π) = 1
  rw [Set.Icc.coe_one, Set.Icc.coe_zero, mul_one, mul_zero, sub_zero, div_self h2pi]

blocks.tex: Normalize $R e^{2\pi it}$ by its norm $R$ and use the lift $2\pi t$.

blocks.label: thm:discrete_import_degree
blocks.title: Nonzero boundary winding attains the avoided value
blocks.body:
Let $R>0$, let $F:\mathbb C\to\mathbb C$ be continuous on the closed
ball of center $c$ and radius $R$, and suppose $F(z)\ne w$ on its sphere.
If the circle boundary path of $F$ has nonzero winding about $w$, then
there exists $z$ in the open ball with $F(z)=w$.

lean.name: Complex.exists_eq_of_windingNumberAt_ne_zero
lean.code:
theorem exists_eq_of_windingNumberAt_ne_zero (F : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (w : ℂ)
    (hF : ContinuousOn F (closedBall c R)) (hbd : ∀ z ∈ sphere c R, F z ≠ w)
    (hw : windingNumberAt w
      (circleLoop F c R (hF.mono (sphere_subset_closedBall.trans
        (closedBall_subset_closedBall (abs_of_pos hR).le))))
      (circleLoop_ne F c R w _
        fun z hz ↦ hbd z (mem_sphere.2 ((mem_sphere.1 hz).trans (abs_of_pos hR)))) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ z ∈ ball c R, F z = w := by
  by_contra hcon
  simp only [not_exists, not_and] at hcon
  have hFs : ContinuousOn F (sphere c |R|) :=
    hF.mono (sphere_subset_closedBall.trans (closedBall_subset_closedBall (abs_of_pos hR).le))
  have hbd' : ∀ z ∈ sphere c |R|, F z ≠ w :=
    fun z hz ↦ hbd z (mem_sphere.2 ((mem_sphere.1 hz).trans (abs_of_pos hR)))
  have hne : ∀ z ∈ closedBall c R, F z ≠ w := by
    intro z hz
    rcases (mem_closedBall.1 hz).lt_or_eq with h | h
    · exact hcon z (mem_ball.2 h)
    · exact hbd z (mem_sphere.2 h)
  have hFc : F c ≠ w := hne c (mem_closedBall_self hR.le)
  set pt : I × I → ℂ := fun st ↦ c + ((st.1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * circleMap 0 R (2 * π * st.2)
    with hptdef
  have hptcont : Continuous pt := by
    rw [hptdef]
    exact continuous_const.add ((continuous_ofReal.comp
      (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst)).mul ((continuous_circleMap 0 R).comp
        (continuous_const.mul (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd))))
  have hptmem : ∀ st : I × I, pt st ∈ closedBall c R := by
    intro st
    have hnorm : ‖pt st - c‖ = (st.1 : ℝ) * R := by
      rw [hptdef]
      simp only [add_sub_cancel_left, norm_mul, norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        norm_circleMap_zero, abs_of_nonneg st.1.2.1, abs_of_pos hR]
    rw [mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, hnorm]
    nlinarith [st.1.2.2, hR.le]
  have hFptcont : Continuous fun st ↦ F (pt st) := hF.comp_continuous hptcont hptmem
  have hFptne : ∀ st, F (pt st) ≠ w := fun st ↦ hne _ (hptmem st)
  set Hmap : C(I × I, Circle) :=
    ⟨fun st ↦ circleProjAt w (F (pt st)) (hFptne st), continuous_circleProjAt hFptcont hFptne⟩
  have h0 : ∀ t, Hmap (0, t) = (ContinuousMap.const I (circleProjAt w (F c) hFc)) t := by
    intro t
    change circleProjAt w (F (pt (0, t))) (hFptne (0, t)) = circleProjAt w (F c) hFc
    apply circleProjAt_congr
    have hpt0 : pt (0, t) = c := by simp [hptdef]
    rw [hpt0]
  have h1 : ∀ t, Hmap (1, t) =
      normLoopAt w (circleLoop F c R hFs) (circleLoop_ne F c R w hFs hbd') t := by
    intro t
    change circleProjAt w (F (pt (1, t))) (hFptne (1, t)) =
      circleProjAt w (circleLoop F c R hFs t) (circleLoop_ne F c R w hFs hbd' t)
    apply circleProjAt_congr
    change F (pt (1, t)) = F (circleMap c R (2 * π * t))
    congr 1
    simp [hptdef, circleMap]
  have hloop : ∀ s, Hmap (s, 0) = Hmap (s, 1) := by
    intro s
    change circleProjAt w (F (pt (s, 0))) (hFptne (s, 0)) =
      circleProjAt w (F (pt (s, 1))) (hFptne (s, 1))
    apply circleProjAt_congr
    have hpt : pt (s, 0) = pt (s, 1) := by
  -- … (truncated)

blocks.tex:
If there were no such interior point, the boundary hypothesis would make
$F-w$ nonzero on the entire closed ball.  The paths
$t\mapsto F(c+sR e^{2\pi it})$, $0\le s\le1$, form an avoiding free
homotopy of loops from the constant $F(c)$ to the boundary path.
The normalized-loop homotopy argument forces boundary winding zero.

blocks.label: def:discrete_winding_number_c
blocks.title: Origin-centered winding
blocks.body:
For $\gamma\in C(I,\mathbb C)$ avoiding zero, normalize by
$\gamma(t)/\|\gamma(t)\|$, take the chosen circle-covering angle lift,
and divide its endpoint increment by $2\pi$.  Write this as $W_C(\gamma)$.
The private bridge in \texttt{Gluck/Winding.lean} identifies it with
$W_0(\gamma)$ by the polar-lift evaluation rule.  Closedness is not a
hypothesis of this definition.

lean.name: Gluck.windingNumberC
lean.code:
noncomputable def windingNumberC (γ : C(I, ℂ)) (h : ∀ t, γ t ≠ 0) : ℝ :=
  windingNumber (normLoop γ h)

blocks.label: thm:discrete_winding_number_c_homotopy
blocks.title: Gluck free-homotopy interface
blocks.body:
For two nowhere-zero paths and a nowhere-zero $H\in C(I\times I,\mathbb C)$
with those paths as its $s=0,1$ endpoints and $H(s,0)=H(s,1)$ for every
$s$, their $W_C$ values agree.

lean.name: Gluck.windingNumberC_eq_of_homotopy
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberC_eq_of_homotopy (γ₀ γ₁ : C(I, ℂ))
    (hγ₀ : ∀ t, γ₀ t ≠ 0) (hγ₁ : ∀ t, γ₁ t ≠ 0)
    (H : C(I × I, ℂ)) (hH : ∀ st, H st ≠ 0)
    (h0 : ∀ t, H (0, t) = γ₀ t) (h1 : ∀ t, H (1, t) = γ₁ t)
    (hloop : ∀ s, H (s, 0) = H (s, 1)) :
    windingNumberC γ₀ hγ₀ = windingNumberC γ₁ hγ₁ := by
  rw [windingNumberC_eq_windingNumberAt, windingNumberC_eq_windingNumberAt]
  exact Complex.windingNumberAt_eq_of_homotopy 0 γ₀ γ₁ hγ₀ hγ₁ H hH h0 h1 hloop

/-! ## The boundary loop of a map on the closed unit disk -/

blocks.tex:
Apply the private bridge at both ends and the general free-homotopy theorem
with avoided point zero.

blocks.label: lem:discrete_winding_number_c_perturb
blocks.title: One-sided perturbation interface
blocks.body:
Let $\gamma,\gamma'$ be nowhere-zero continuous paths, both closed, and
suppose $\|\gamma'(t)-\gamma(t)\|<\|\gamma(t)\|$ for all $t$.
Then $W_C(\gamma)=W_C(\gamma')$.

lean.name: Gluck.windingNumberC_eq_of_perturb
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberC_eq_of_perturb (γ γ' : C(I, ℂ))
    (hγ : ∀ t, γ t ≠ 0) (hγ' : ∀ t, γ' t ≠ 0)
    (hloopγ : γ 0 = γ 1) (hloopγ' : γ' 0 = γ' 1)
    (hpert : ∀ t, ‖γ' t - γ t‖ < ‖γ t‖) :
    windingNumberC γ hγ = windingNumberC γ' hγ' := by
  rw [windingNumberC_eq_windingNumberAt, windingNumberC_eq_windingNumberAt]
  have hpert' : ∀ t, ‖γ' t - γ t‖ < ‖γ t - 0‖ + ‖γ' t - 0‖ := fun t => by
    rw [sub_zero, sub_zero]
    exact (hpert t).trans_le (le_add_of_nonneg_right (norm_nonneg _))
  exact Complex.windingNumberAt_eq_of_norm_sub_lt 0 γ γ' hloopγ hloopγ' hpert'

blocks.tex:
The one-sided bound implies the symmetric bound after adding the
nonnegative norm $\|\gamma'(t)\|$.  Use the private bridge and the symmetric
perturbation theorem at zero.  All four original nonvanishing and
closedness hypotheses are retained in this interface.

blocks.label: def:discrete_exp_loop
blocks.title: Forward exponential model
blocks.body:
For $c\in\mathbb C$, set $E_c(t)=c e^{2\pi it}$ as a bundled continuous
path.  Both endpoints equal $c$, and its norm is constantly $\|c\|$.

lean.name: Gluck.expLoop
lean.code:
noncomputable def expLoop (c : ℂ) : C(I, ℂ) :=
  ⟨fun t ↦ c * Complex.exp (((2 * π * (t : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I), by fun_prop⟩

@[simp]

blocks.label: def:discrete_exp_loop_rev
blocks.title: Reverse exponential model
blocks.body:
For $c\in\mathbb C$, set $E^-_c(t)=c e^{-2\pi it}$ as a bundled
continuous path.  Both endpoints equal $c$, and its norm is $\|c\|$.

lean.name: Gluck.expLoopRev
lean.code:
noncomputable def expLoopRev (c : ℂ) : C(I, ℂ) :=
  ⟨fun t ↦ c * Complex.exp (((-(2 * π * (t : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I), by fun_prop⟩

@[simp]

blocks.label: lem:discrete_winding_number_c_exp_loop
blocks.title: Forward model winding
blocks.body: For $c\ne0$, $E_c$ is nowhere zero and $W_C(E_c)=1$.

lean.name: Gluck.windingNumberC_expLoop
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberC_expLoop (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    windingNumberC (expLoop c) (expLoop_ne_zero c hc) = 1 := by
  rw [windingNumberC_eq_windingNumberAt]
  let γ : C(I, ℂ) :=
    ⟨fun t ↦ Complex.exp ((2 * π * (1 : ℤ) * (t : ℝ) : ℝ) * Complex.I), by fun_prop⟩
  have hγ : ∀ t, γ t ≠ 0 := fun _ ↦ Complex.exp_ne_zero _
  calc
    Complex.windingNumberAt 0 (expLoop c) (expLoop_ne_zero c hc) =
        Complex.windingNumberAt 0
          ⟨fun t ↦ c * γ t, continuous_const.mul γ.continuous⟩
          (fun t ↦ mul_ne_zero hc (hγ t)) :=
      Complex.windingNumberAt_congr fun t ↦ by simp [γ, expLoop]
    _ = Complex.windingNumberAt 0 γ hγ :=
      Complex.windingNumberAt_const_mul c hc γ hγ
    _ = 1 := by simpa [γ] using Complex.windingNumberAt_exp_int_mul 1

blocks.tex:
Bridge to $W_0$, identify the path with $c$ times the integer exponential
path for $k=1$, remove the nonzero constant, and evaluate that winding.

blocks.label: lem:discrete_winding_number_c_exp_loop_rev
blocks.title: Reverse model winding
blocks.body: For $c\ne0$, $E^-_c$ is nowhere zero and $W_C(E^-_c)=-1$.

lean.name: Gluck.windingNumberC_expLoopRev
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberC_expLoopRev (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    windingNumberC (expLoopRev c) (expLoopRev_ne_zero c hc) = -1 := by
  rw [windingNumberC_eq_windingNumberAt]
  let γ : C(I, ℂ) :=
    ⟨fun t ↦ Complex.exp ((2 * π * (-1 : ℤ) * (t : ℝ) : ℝ) * Complex.I), by fun_prop⟩
  have hγ : ∀ t, γ t ≠ 0 := fun _ ↦ Complex.exp_ne_zero _
  calc
    Complex.windingNumberAt 0 (expLoopRev c) (expLoopRev_ne_zero c hc) =
        Complex.windingNumberAt 0
          ⟨fun t ↦ c * γ t, continuous_const.mul γ.continuous⟩
          (fun t ↦ mul_ne_zero hc (hγ t)) :=
      Complex.windingNumberAt_congr fun t ↦ by simp [γ, expLoopRev]
    _ = Complex.windingNumberAt 0 γ hγ :=
      Complex.windingNumberAt_const_mul c hc γ hγ
    _ = -1 := by simpa [γ] using Complex.windingNumberAt_exp_int_mul (-1)

blocks.tex: Use the same constant-scaling computation with integer $k=-1$.

blocks.label: def:discrete_linear_loop
blocks.title: Real-linear boundary model
blocks.body:
For $a,b\in\mathbb C$, put $L_{a,b}(t)=E_a(t)+E^-_b(t)$.
This is the boundary path of $z\mapsto az+b\overline z$.

lean.name: Gluck.linearLoop
lean.code:
noncomputable def linearLoop (a b : ℂ) : C(I, ℂ) :=
  ⟨fun t ↦ expLoop a t + expLoopRev b t,
    (expLoop a).continuous.add (expLoopRev b).continuous⟩

@[simp]

blocks.label: lem:discrete_winding_number_c_linear_loop
blocks.title: Real-linear model winding
blocks.body:
For $\|a\|\ne\|b\|$, the path $L_{a,b}$ avoids zero and
$W_C(L_{a,b})=1$ if $\|b\|<\|a\|$, and $-1$ otherwise.

lean.name: Gluck.windingNumberC_linearLoop
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberC_linearLoop (a b : ℂ) (hab : ‖a‖ ≠ ‖b‖) :
    windingNumberC (linearLoop a b) (linearLoop_ne_zero a b hab) =
      if ‖b‖ < ‖a‖ then 1 else -1 := by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hab with hlt | hgt
  · rw [if_neg (asymm hlt)]
    have hb : b ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.1 (lt_of_le_of_lt (norm_nonneg a) hlt)
    have hpert : ∀ t : I, ‖linearLoop a b t - expLoopRev b t‖ < ‖expLoopRev b t‖ := by
      intro t
      have he : linearLoop a b t - expLoopRev b t = expLoop a t := by
        change expLoop a t + expLoopRev b t - expLoopRev b t = expLoop a t
        ring
      rw [he, expLoop_norm, expLoopRev_norm]
      exact hlt
    have h := windingNumberC_eq_of_perturb (expLoopRev b) (linearLoop a b)
      (expLoopRev_ne_zero b hb) (linearLoop_ne_zero a b hab)
      (expLoopRev_loop b) (linearLoop_loop a b) hpert
    rw [← h, windingNumberC_expLoopRev b hb]
  · rw [if_pos hgt]
    have ha : a ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.1 (lt_of_le_of_lt (norm_nonneg b) hgt)
    have hpert : ∀ t : I, ‖linearLoop a b t - expLoop a t‖ < ‖expLoop a t‖ := by
      intro t
      have he : linearLoop a b t - expLoop a t = expLoopRev b t := by
        change expLoop a t + expLoopRev b t - expLoop a t = expLoopRev b t
        ring
      rw [he, expLoopRev_norm, expLoop_norm]
      exact hgt
    have h := windingNumberC_eq_of_perturb (expLoop a) (linearLoop a b)
      (expLoop_ne_zero a ha) (linearLoop_ne_zero a b hab)
      (expLoop_loop a) (linearLoop_loop a b) hpert
    rw [← h, windingNumberC_expLoop a ha]

blocks.tex:
A zero would force the two summands to have equal norms, contrary to the
hypothesis.  When $\|b\|<\|a\|$, its difference from $E_a$ has norm
$\|b\|<\|a\|$, so one-sided perturbation gives winding $1$.
In the other case compare with $E^-_b$ to get $-1$.

blocks.label: thm:discrete_poincare_miranda_rect
blocks.title: Poincare--Miranda with weak face inequalities
blocks.body:
Let $a_1\le a_2$, $b_1\le b_2$, and let
$G:\mathbb R^2\to\mathbb R^2$ be continuous on
$K=[a_1,a_2]\times[b_1,b_2]$.  Assume $G_1(a_1,y)\le0$ and
$G_1(a_2,y)\ge0$ for every $y\in[b_1,b_2]$, and $G_2(x,b_1)\le0$ and
$G_2(x,b_2)\ge0$ for every $x\in[a_1,a_2]$.
Then there is $p\in K$ with $G(p)=0$.  Degenerate rectangles and boundary
zeros are allowed.

lean.name: poincare_miranda
lean.code:
theorem poincare_miranda {a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : ℝ} (ha : a₁ ≤ a₂) (hb : b₁ ≤ b₂)
    (G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hG : ContinuousOn G (Set.Icc a₁ a₂ ×ˢ Set.Icc b₁ b₂))
    (hleft : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc b₁ b₂, (G (a₁, y)).1 ≤ 0)
    (hright : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc b₁ b₂, 0 ≤ (G (a₂, y)).1)
    (hbot : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a₁ a₂, (G (x, b₁)).2 ≤ 0)
    (htop : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a₁ a₂, 0 ≤ (G (x, b₂)).2) :
    ∃ p ∈ Set.Icc a₁ a₂ ×ˢ Set.Icc b₁ b₂, G p = 0 := by
  rcases ha.eq_or_lt with hae | halt
  · have hxmem : a₁ ∈ Set.Icc a₁ a₂ := ⟨le_rfl, ha⟩
    have hg1 : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc b₁ b₂, (G (a₁, y)).1 = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      have h1 := hleft y hy
      have h2 := hright y hy
      rw [← hae] at h2
      linarith
    have hfcont : ContinuousOn (fun y ↦ G (a₁, y)) (Set.Icc b₁ b₂) :=
      hG.comp ((continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousOn)
        (fun y hy ↦ Set.mk_mem_prod hxmem hy)
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun y ↦ (G (a₁, y)).2) (Set.Icc b₁ b₂) :=
      continuous_snd.comp_continuousOn hfcont
    have hmem : (0 : ℝ) ∈
        Set.Icc ((fun y ↦ (G (a₁, y)).2) b₁) ((fun y ↦ (G (a₁, y)).2) b₂) :=
      ⟨hbot a₁ hxmem, htop a₁ hxmem⟩
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀mem, hy₀⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc hb hcont hmem
    exact ⟨(a₁, y₀), Set.mk_mem_prod hxmem hy₀mem, Prod.ext (hg1 y₀ hy₀mem) hy₀⟩
  rcases hb.eq_or_lt with hbe | hblt
  · have hymem : b₁ ∈ Set.Icc b₁ b₂ := ⟨le_rfl, hb⟩
    have hg2 : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a₁ a₂, (G (x, b₁)).2 = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      have h1 := hbot x hx
      have h2 := htop x hx
      rw [← hbe] at h2
      linarith
    have hfcont : ContinuousOn (fun x ↦ G (x, b₁)) (Set.Icc a₁ a₂) :=
      hG.comp ((continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn)
        (fun x hx ↦ Set.mk_mem_prod hx hymem)
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun x ↦ (G (x, b₁)).1) (Set.Icc a₁ a₂) :=
      continuous_fst.comp_continuousOn hfcont
    have hmem : (0 : ℝ) ∈
        Set.Icc ((fun x ↦ (G (x, b₁)).1) a₁) ((fun x ↦ (G (x, b₁)).1) a₂) :=
      ⟨hleft b₁ hymem, hright b₁ hymem⟩
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀mem, hx₀⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc ha hcont hmem
    exact ⟨(x₀, b₁), Set.mk_mem_prod hx₀mem hymem, Prod.ext hx₀ (hg2 x₀ hx₀mem)⟩
  set K : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Set.Icc a₁ a₂ ×ˢ Set.Icc b₁ b₂
  have hKcomp : IsCompact K := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
  set cx : ℝ := (a₁ + a₂) / 2 with hcx
  set cy : ℝ := (b₁ + b₂) / 2 with hcy
  set w : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ := fun p ↦ (p.1 - cx, p.2 - cy) with hw
  have hwcont : Continuous w := by fun_prop
  set Gn : ℕ → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ := fun n p ↦ G p + (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) • w p with hGn
  have hpos : ∀ n : ℕ, (0 : ℝ) < 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := fun n ↦ by positivity
  have hzero : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ p ∈ K, Gn n p = 0 := by
    intro n
    apply poincare_miranda_of_lt halt hblt (Gn n)
    · exact hG.add (Continuous.continuousOn (by fun_prop))
    · intro y hy
      have hGl := hleft y hy
      have he : (Gn n (a₁, y)).1 = (G (a₁, y)).1 + (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) * (a₁ - cx) := by
        simp [hGn, hw]
  -- … (truncated)

deps.title: Nonzero boundary winding attains the avoided value
deps.label: thm:discrete_import_degree

blocks.tex:
On a degenerate side the two opposing inequalities force the corresponding
component to vanish identically, and the one-dimensional intermediate value
theorem finds a zero of the other component.
For a nondegenerate rectangle with strict face signs, use the continuous
disk-to-square chart $z\mapsto (\|z\|/\max(|\Re z|,|\Im z|))z$, extended
by zero at the origin, followed by the affine map to $K$.  The norm of the
first chart is at most $2\|z\|$, which proves continuity at zero.
The pulled-back boundary path shares successively the right, top, left,
and bottom open half-planes with the unit circle on the arcs split at
$1/8,3/8,5/8,7/8$.  On each arc the symmetric perturbation inequality is
strict.  Its winding is therefore $1$, and the disk degree theorem gives
a zero.  These chart and four-arc steps are private helpers in the source.
For weak signs, set $G_j(p)=G(p)+(j+1)^{-1}(p-c)$, where $c$ is the
rectangle center.  These maps have strict face signs.  Choose their zeros
in compact $K$ and a convergent subsequence.  The perturbations tend to
zero along it, so continuity gives a zero of $G$ at the limiting point.
